metadata.title: Assessment evidence guide for enterprise IT - Potential Evidence Sources OSCAL Control Mapping

remarks.p: Consumers of this file should refer to the Essentials OSCAL NS 1.0 page for information regarding the Essentials specific representation used in this OSCAL file.

mapping-description.p: This file is generated from the Potential Evidence Sources in the Assessment evidence guide for enterprise IT.

Organisations may choose to leverage controls from a variety of sources when addressing the Essentials principles. The effectiveness of a mitigation must also be considered in context of each individual domain, rather than organisation wide; a set of controls that may be effective for one domain does not automatically guarantee effectiveness for another domain.

References to independent cyber security frameworks have been included for each action, which indicate where supporting evidence of that action’s effectiveness may exist (if an organisation has adopted that framework already). The list is not intended to define the controls required to meet the intent of the actions.

remarks.p: The mapped resource is a control catalog that is not provided in an OSCAL format.
